notes.title: 27th March hotfix
notes.notes: - Fixed unhandled default locale selector failure. Default locale when locale detection fails will now be English.

notes.title: Update notes for March 27th
notes.notes:
- Flying now starts at near boost speed
- Added warning sfx when at low energy
- Fixed UI scaling issues in modification menu
- Some minor UI improvements
- Fixed timing bug in Capture objective
- Introduced xp crystal culling for lategame FPS issues
- Fixed level up issue when levels are gained too quickly
- Added GameTester API integration

notes.title: 10th March 2025 test update
notes.notes:
- Highscore system added
- First weapon selected now autoconnects second weapon selected
- Various graphical updates

notes.title: Elite enemy update
notes.notes:
Added elite enemies that appear at regular intervals and drop randomised powerups that power up the player for the rest of the run
Fixed some inventory bugs

notes.title: Minor bugfixes 19thNov
notes.notes:
Bugfixes:
Fixed ion cannon issue after all points captured
Fixed capture building overlap

notes.title: Patch #2
notes.notes:
Features:

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.notes:
Localisation:
Added dynamic font fall through for east asian languages
Game now sets default locale based on system language if not set in playerprefs

Loadout:
UX overhaul using hexloadout completed and mostly stable
Added gameicons for weapons and upgrades
Added highlights showing stats upgraded
